China is reportedly dealing with an outbreak of the HMPV, 5 years after the Covid-19 pandemic. Videos online show crowded hospitals, with some users saying that multiple viruses, including influenza A, HMPV, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and #COVID_19, are circulating.
